findings.text: follow-on: the resume attempt counter is cumulative across rounds, not per-round — _record_repair_dispatch increments the pointer's repair_dispatch.attempt without regard to round_id, and dispatch_repair_for_run:2301 reads it as prior for the same round. So REPAIR_RESUME_LIMIT=2 yields two resumes only for the run's first round; once the reviewed head moves, the new round's first resume records attempt 3, and the next sweep finds prior >= 2 and marks it exhausted after a single resume. Reproduced: with a second review at an advanced head, round two resumed once, not twice (attempt 5, status exhausted) — review-probe-crossround.log.

follow-on: the exhaustion reason is the literal 'the round was resumed twice without answering its findings' while the bound is REPAIR_RESUME_LIMIT; and it is written for a round whose prior outcome may be a refusal rather than a resume, so the recorded cause can misstate how many times the round was actually resumed.
